name: Mercado do Bolhão
description: Immerse yourself in the bustling heart of Porto's food scene. A perfect Saturday outing for fresh oysters, local cheeses, and a classic bacalhau lunch.
longDescription:
The Mercado do Bolhão is a historic municipal market in Central Porto, operating since 1914. It serves as a central hub for local producers and vendors to sell fresh produce, meat, fish, and other regional specialties directly to the public. The market's purpose is to preserve traditional commerce and provide access to high-quality Portuguese ingredients.

Visitors to the Mercado do Bolhão on May 2nd, 2026, can expect a lively atmosphere within a grand, multi-level historic building. The market offers an opportunity to observe daily life in Porto and engage with local vendors. The duration of a visit can vary, but many spend a few hours exploring the stalls and sampling food. The primary language spoken is Portuguese, though many vendors have some English proficiency. The market attracts a diverse audience, including locals doing their weekly shopping and tourists seeking an authentic cultural experience.

Entry to the Mercado do Bolhão is free. The market is centrally located and easily accessible, approximately a 5-minute walk from Bolhão metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) and a 10-minute walk from Trindade metro station (all lines). It is also within walking distance of many central Porto landmarks. The market is generally family-friendly, with wide aisles and a welcoming environment.
